message.content:
This document is a technical README and engineering log for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for running very large Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models on consumer and prosumer hardware. Here are the key technical points:

## Core Architecture & Models
- **Engine lineage:** Built on Strata (MIT), with ggml/llama.cpp for quantization formats and CPU kernels; EXL3 support follows exllamav3; DFlash2 drafting follows beellama.cpp.
- **Supported models:** GLM-5.3-Flash (320B, 18B active), DeepSeek
